description: He wears a calf-length deep burgundy textured open-front coat with gold geometric edging at the collar, front bands, cuffs and hem. Beneath is an ivory tunic with gold decorated front and hem borders and a short upright split collar. A brown leather belt with a round gold buckle and long hanging strap secures the waist. Pale ivory trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots. The garment is unarmored and his head is uncovered. He holds no weapons and wears no crown.
